projects.title: Al-Khaliji Real Estate — Social Media Post Design
projects.description: A professional social media post designed for Al-Khaliji Real Estate to promote real estate investment and communicate the brand's services in a modern, trustworthy, and visually engaging way. The design combines a dark architectural background with a refined blue and orange color palette to create a premium real estate aesthetic.

images.alt: Al-Khaleeji Real Estate social media post
images.label: Social Media Design

projects.challenge: Create a professional social media advertisement for Al-Khaliji Real Estate that promotes real estate investment and highlights the company's key services while maintaining a modern and trustworthy visual appearance.
projects.approach: I developed a premium visual composition using a dark architectural environment as the main background, supported by a blue and orange color palette. The layout combines Arabic promotional typography, service icons, contact information, and real estate imagery to create a clear visual hierarchy while maintaining a strong corporate feel.
projects.result: The final design delivers a modern and professional social media advertisement that communicates Al-Khaliji Real Estate's services clearly and builds a sense of trust and credibility. The combination of architectural imagery, strong typography, and contrasting brand colors creates an engaging visual suitable for real estate marketing campaigns.

projects.title: Al-Khaleegi Real Estate — Logo Design
projects.description: A modern and luxurious logo design created for Al-Khaleegi Real Estate, a real estate and investment brand. The identity combines architectural forms with Arabic visual elements to communicate trust, stability, growth, and professionalism while maintaining a premium and distinctive appearance.
projects.challenge: Design a distinctive and professional logo for Al-Khaleegi Real Estate that reflects the company's focus on real estate investment while establishing a sense of trust, stability, luxury, and long-term growth.
projects.approach: I developed the logo around a stylized architectural skyline to represent the real estate industry and the idea of growth and development. The combination of gold and dark tones creates a luxurious and premium appearance, while the Arabic typography reinforces the brand's local identity and connection to the regional market.
projects.result: The final logo presents Al-Khaleegi Real Estate as a modern, trustworthy, and premium real estate brand. The architectural symbol and refined gold treatment create a strong visual identity that can be applied across digital platforms, marketing materials, and corporate branding.

projects.title: Al-Khaliji Agricultural Reclamation Co. — Social Media Post Design
projects.description: A professional social media post designed for Al-Khaliji Agricultural Reclamation Co. to promote its agricultural land reclamation and development services. The design uses a vibrant green visual direction, agricultural imagery, and structured service sections to communicate the company's capabilities and commitment to sustainable agricultural development.

images.alt: Al-Khaliji Agricultural Reclamation Co. — Social Media Post Design
images.label: Social media design

projects.challenge: Create an engaging social media design for Al-Khaliji Agricultural Reclamation Co. that highlights its agricultural services, land development capabilities, and commitment to supporting modern and sustainable agriculture.
projects.approach: I built the design around a strong agricultural visual theme using a green color palette and a wide farmland image as the main visual. The services were organized into three clear sections, supported by custom-style icons and concise Arabic messaging to make the information easy to scan while maintaining a professional corporate appearance.
projects.result: The final design presents the company's agricultural services in a clear, professional, and visually engaging format. The combination of natural imagery, green tones, structured information, and strong typography creates a cohesive social media advertisement suited to the agricultural and land reclamation industry.

projects.title: Al-Khaleegi Agricultural Reclamation – Logo Design
projects.description: A modern and professional logo design created for Al-Khaleegi for Agricultural Reclamation. The visual identity combines agricultural elements with a clean, contemporary style to communicate growth, sustainability, development, and professionalism.
projects.challenge: Create a professional and distinctive logo for an agricultural reclamation company that reflects its connection to agriculture, land development, and sustainable growth.
projects.approach: I developed a modern visual symbol inspired by agricultural elements, combining a wheat ear with stylized land and field lines. The green color represents agriculture, growth, and sustainability, while the gold typography adds a professional and premium character to the identity.
projects.result: A clean and memorable logo that communicates the company's agricultural focus while maintaining a professional and modern visual presence suitable for branding, digital platforms, and corporate applications.

projects.title: Black Oud – Social Media Design
projects.description: An informal social media post design created for Black Oud to promote a premium natural oud product. The design combines warm, luxurious tones with an elegant Eastern-inspired atmosphere to communicate the product’s natural character, authenticity, and premium quality.
projects.challenge: Create an engaging social media post for Black Oud that presents the product in a luxurious and authentic visual environment while highlighting its natural Eastern character.
projects.approach: I created a warm, premium composition using a dark interior setting, golden lighting, traditional decorative elements, and the oud product as the main focal point. The typography and gold accents were designed to reinforce the luxurious and authentic character of the product.
projects.result: A visually rich social media design that presents Black Oud as a premium, authentic product and creates a strong connection between the product and the traditional Eastern atmosphere.

projects.title: Spero Spathis – Social Media Design
projects.description: An informal social media post design created for Spero Spathis to promote its refreshing orange drink. The composition uses vibrant orange tones, fresh citrus elements, dynamic water splashes, and the product as the main focal point to create an energetic and refreshing visual.
projects.challenge: Create an eye-catching social media post for Spero Spathis that communicates the freshness and energetic character of its orange drink.
projects.approach: I built a vibrant composition around the product using oranges, fresh leaves, water splashes, and a warm orange-to-yellow background. The dynamic arrangement and strong product focus were designed to create a juicy, refreshing, and energetic feeling.
projects.result: A bold and engaging social media visual that highlights the product while communicating freshness, energy, and the refreshing character of the orange drink.

projects.title: Al-Khodewy – Book Cover Design
projects.description: A professional book cover design created for Mr. El-Khodewy, inspired by ancient Egyptian heritage and historical themes. The design combines a dark premium aesthetic with Egyptian-inspired visual elements and gold typography to communicate knowledge, strength, and history.
projects.challenge: Create a distinctive book cover for Mr. El-Khodewy that reflects historical and educational content while giving the book a strong, premium, and memorable visual identity.
projects.approach: I used a dark black-and-gold visual direction inspired by ancient Egyptian aesthetics. The central historical figure, metallic gold typography, and restrained composition were combined to create a sophisticated cover that connects the subject with Egyptian history while maintaining a modern professional appearance.
projects.result: A complete book-cover design presented across the front cover, back cover, and spine, with a cohesive visual language suitable for a printed educational and historical publication.

projects.title: Al-Beyh – Book Cover Design
projects.description: A professional math guide book cover design created for Mr. Abdelazim El-Bey. The design combines educational elements, mathematical symbols, and a friendly student character to create an engaging and approachable visual identity for educational content. The blue color palette and dynamic composition were chosen to communicate clarity, energy, and a student-friendly learning experience.
projects.role: Graphic Designer — Book Cover Design & Print Design
projects.challenge: The client needed a professional and engaging book cover for a mathematics guide aimed at school students. The design needed to communicate the educational nature of the book while remaining visually attractive and approachable for younger learners.
projects.approach: I developed a visually dynamic composition built around a student character, mathematical symbols, numbers, and educational elements. A blue-based color palette was used to create a clean and energetic academic feel, while the typography and visual hierarchy were carefully arranged to keep the book title and essential information clear and prominent. Adobe Photoshop was used to create and refine the complete cover design.
projects.result: The final design delivers a modern and engaging educational book cover that combines academic content with a friendly visual style. The result is designed to stand out on a bookshelf while maintaining clear communication and a professional appearance suitable for educational publishing.
